chunks: Abu Basir asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a sheep that is slaughtered but does not move, while a great amount of fresh blood pours from it, so he said:
"Do not eat. Indeed, Ali عليه السلام used to say: If the leg kicks or the eye blinks, then eat."

key_terms.الشَّاةِ: the sheep being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.تُذْبَحُ: is slaughtered according to the case in question
key_terms.فَكُلْ: then eat, meaning it is permissible to consume

ai.seo_question: What are the signs that a slaughtered sheep may be eaten in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a slaughtered sheep whose signs of life are doubtful. It indicates that abundant fresh blood alone is not sufficient; a confirming sign such as movement of the leg or blinking of the eye establishes permissibility to eat.
